Description:

**Signia Aerospace** is built on decades of proven performance and partnership in the aircraft systems industry. The proven brands that operate under the Signia Aerospace ecosystem lead the field in thermal management and mission-specific equipment. They are the brands of choice for pilots, maintenance directors, ground crews, and supply chain professionals worldwide, in commercial, private, and military applications. Our depth of expertise and unique pool of resources allows us to act as an integrated, nimble partner in the design, manufacture, delivery, and service of highly specialized aircraft systems and components.

**Company Name:** Plane Exhaust Corp. (A Hartzell Aerospace Welding division).

Founded in 2002, Plane Exhaust Corporation. is backed by over 24 years of experience in aircraft exhaust system repair, overhaul and modification. We provide a large variety of services on any aircraft exhaust system made by any aircraft company with great customer support.

**Our Culture**

We are a team that prides ourselves on a culture that supports shared values of empowerment, accountability, drive, integrity, and respect. Our team shares a deep commitment to safety and collaboration. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance, 401(K) plans with employer match, company provided Growth Participation Units (GPU) and so much more.

Our GPU benefit is unique to the industry and encourages all employees to think like owners and receive future financial reward for contributions to business growth. Join our team to be part of a culture that encourages growth and development and celebrates our success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manages operations within a smaller or less complex manufacturing facility while overseeing production, maintenance, materials, logistics, safety, quality, and operational performance activities. Ensures plant operations meet production, cost, delivery, safety, and quality objectives while supporting workforce development, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives.

All roles at Signia are expected to support the company’s operating model (SOAR) and contribute to the organization’s business value drivers, Profitable New Business, Productivity, Precision M&A, and Value-Based Pricing, through operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

Requirements:

**Key Deliverables of the Position**

1) Achievement of plant production, safety, quality, and delivery objectives

2) Efficient operation of manufacturing, maintenance, and support functions

3) Compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements

4) Effective management of plant budgets, operational costs, and resources

5) Reliable operational scheduling, staffing, and production execution

6) Continuous improvement of operational efficiency and plant performance

7) Effective leadership and development of plant personnel and supervisors

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Typically requires 6+ years of manufacturing or operational leadership experience
* Previous supervisory or management experience required

**Technical Competencies**

1) Manufacturing and plant operations management

2) Production planning and operational execution

3) Safety, quality, and regulatory compliance

4) Budgeting and cost management

5) Workforce leadership and employee development

6) Continuous improvement and operational efficiency

7) Cross-functional operational coordination

8) KPI monitoring and operational reporting

9) Maintenance and facility oversight

10) Proficient Computer Skills – Microsoft Office and ERP/manufacturing systems

11) Excellent Communication Skills – both verbal and written

**Behavioral Competencies – Demonstrates behaviors consistent with our values**

**1)** **Thinks and acts like an owner**

o Uses company resources wisely & cost-effectively

o Shows pride in the organization and a commitment to its long-term success

o Takes full responsibility for their actions

o Holds self to high standards of performance and integrity

**2)** **Demonstrates high integrity**

o Consistently acts with honestly, transparency and high ethics

o Makes decisions based on what is morally right

o Owns their actions and holds self-accountable

**3)** **Puts team above self; in it together**

o Prioritizes team and company over personal gain

o Collaborates with team members within the department and across all functions

Contributes to a positive, inclusive work environment

**4)** **Innovates and improves**

o Actively supports or initiates continuous improvement efforts

o Shares ideas and suggests solutions that enhance team or business performance

o Stays open to feedback and embraces changes

o Demonstrates a bias towards action

**5)** **Honors commitments**

o Consistently follows through on project timelines, meeting and deliverables

o Takes ownership for responsibilities and delivers results

o Makes and holds commitment

o Communicates proactively when challenges arise and adjusts plans to stay on track

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability/E-Verify**

***Join Nicopress — a stable, successful Cleveland-based global manufacturer with nearly 125 years of innovation in connectivity solutions.***

**Lead People. Improve Processes. Make an Impact.**

*Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on improving operations, developing people, and getting results?* Nicopress is looking for an experienced **Director of Plant Operations** to lead our manufacturing operations and help take our performance to the next level.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact in a stable, established manufacturing company where your ideas, leadership, and contributions will be noticed and valued.

What You'll Do

* Lead daily manufacturing operations, ensuring safety, quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Coach and develop production supervisors while building a culture of accountability and teamwork.
* Champion the effective use and optimization of our MRP system to strengthen production planning and inventory management.
* Drive continuous improvement, reduce waste, and improve operational performance.
* Partner closely with senior leadership, engineering, and quality teams to solve problems and move the business forward.

What We're Looking For

* 8–10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Proven success leading production teams and developing supervisors.
* Strong hands-on experience with MRP/ERP systems, production planning, and process improvement.
* A practical, solutions-oriented leader who is equally comfortable on the production floor and collaborating with leadership.
* Experience in precision manufacturing, metalworking, or machining is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary of $50-60k based on experience.
* Work/life balance with a Mon-Fri 8:15 to 4:45 work schedule & no overtime required.
* Full benefits package, including generous paid time off.

**Why Nicopress?**

At Nicopress, you'll enjoy the opportunity to make meaningful improvements without layers of corporate bureaucracy. We're a close-knit manufacturing organization of approximately 50 employees that values quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, lead a great team, and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you!**

Full job description available upon request or interview. Work with us!

*Nicopress is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Pay: $110,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Plant management: 5 years (Required)
* Manufacturing: 8 years (Required)

**Purpose:**

The Senior Manager of Lab Operations & Fermentation Development is responsible for leading efficient, safe, and compliant laboratory operations that ensure accurate testing, support fermentation and manufacturing processes, maintain product quality, and drive continuous improvement through reliable data, standardized procedures, and effective resource management.

**Role Accountabilities:**

* Balance quality, productivity, and safety to achieve results to continuously improve in all areas
* Leads the microbiological support and preparations to assist fermentation process in the microbial lab ensuring performance of microbiological media preparations
* Become proficient with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Maintain adequate laboratory testing supplies within budget
* Assist with assuring all consumable materials inventory is adequate to operate the laboratory in an efficient manner, while staying on budget
* Maintains automated and digitized record keeping and proper documentation for all laboratory testing and analysis
* Conduct finished product quality control analysis including microbial streak plating, serial dilution and spread plating for cell counts, light microscopy, enzyme testing, etc.
* General laboratory maintenance and organization related to cleaning glassware and workspace sanitation, including keeping workspace free from clutter at all times
* Lead proficiency with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Become proficient with data analysis and data entry into Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
* Ensures timely completion and accuracy of all COA’s
* Ensure leadership and documentation in all sampling & testing efforts
* Maintain and ensure full operation of analytical lab and equipment: calibration and validation of data, organization of data (LIMS), HPLC (US-VIS, RID, MS), GC-FID, Leco, Ankom fat and fiber, UV-VIS, ICP, off-gas analyzer, water analysis equipment)
* Perform or assist in ensuring real time monitoring techniques (DO, pH, off-gas, temp, etc.) for successful fermentation and blending manufacturing
* Ensure there is data in a structured system and then ensuring its visibility to the CEO through an online report that updates monthly
* Working non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring
* Lead the creation and follow through on all standard operating procedures as well as requirements set by SFSF, NASC, SGF and FAMI-QS
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in laboratory operations, analytical testing, microbiology, or fermentation processes, with leadership experience preferred
* Strong knowledge of microbiological testing, sample preparation, and quality control procedures
* Experience with analytical laboratory equipment, including HPLC, GC, ICP, UV-VIS, and protein, fat, and fiber analysis
* Ability to manage laboratory budgets, inventory, supplies, and resources effectively
* Ability to work flexible or non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring and manufacturing operations
* Familiarity with SFSF, NASC, SGF, and FAMI-QS standards is preferred

**Required Skills:**

* Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Experience with equipment calibration, validation, troubleshooting, and laboratory maintenance
* Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure regulatory compliance
* Proficient in aseptic techniques, environmental monitoring programs (EMP), microorganism culturing and the maintenance and propagation of organism libraries
* Familiarity with LIMS, HPLC, LC-MS, and other analytical methods such as ash, fiber and fat analysis is a plus
* Strong understanding of laboratory safety regulations and quality management systems
* Commitment to workplace safety, quality assurance, continuous improvement, and accurate reporting

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
**Lead the Build of Breakthrough Semiconductor Tools**
------------------------------------------------------

We’re partnering with an established, innovation‑driven manufacturer of advanced semiconductor capital equipment to hire a Director of Manufacturing Operations. You’ll own factory execution from sub-assembly through final test, elevating output, quality, and delivery performance for sophisticated, low‑volume/high‑mix systems.

### **What You’ll Lead**

* Oversee daily operations across sub-assembly, full system build, integration, and final acceptance test.
* Own on‑time shipments, first‑pass yield, product quality, and adherence to production schedules and customer commitments.
* Translate business goals into a scalable manufacturing strategy aligned to demand and growth.
* Remove bottlenecks, balance resources, and resolve operational constraints to maintain consistent throughput.
* Institutionalize performance metrics and structured problem-solving to drive accountability and decisive action.
* Align capacity, staffing, and material readiness to production plans.

### **How You’ll Drive Performance**

* Build and manage operating budgets, labor utilization models, and production cost targets.
* Report on output, shipment-driven revenue performance, overhead, OpEx, and capacity utilization with clear narratives and data.
* Present factory results, risks, and corrective roadmaps to senior leadership.
* Continuously identify cost, resource, and productivity improvements.
* Support strategic planning through capacity assessments, operational forecasting, and data‑driven recommendations.

### **Team & Culture**

* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, engineers, technicians, and operations support.
* Foster a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Assess organizational capability, close leadership gaps, and implement development plans.
* Make timely decisions to resolve performance issues and operational challenges.
* Champion a high‑performance culture grounded in safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Partner effectively with engineering, quality, supply chain, and the executive team.

### **Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Model proactive safety practices and compliance with relevant manufacturing and quality standards.
* Improve product quality, consistency, first‑pass yield, and customer outcomes.
* Lead root-cause and corrective action using 8D, Lean, Six Sigma, and SPC.
* Execute CI roadmaps focused on cycle‑time reduction, efficiency, waste elimination, and scalability.
* Drive upstream quality to catch and fix issues earlier in the process.
* Maintain ISO certifications and the quality management system.

### **Manufacturing Engineering & Process Optimization**

* Collaborate with engineering to enhance manufacturability, assembly flow, and test effectiveness.
* Advance test strategies: modular testing, parallel execution, and automation.
* Cut final system test cycle times while safeguarding stringent quality standards.
* Enable NPI, engineering changes, and production transitions with robust readiness plans.
* Work with global suppliers and contract manufacturers to meet demand and performance targets.
* Lead insourcing/outsourcing and production transfers when needed.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Physics, Operations Management, or related technical field.
* 5+ years total in manufacturing/operations and 5+ years leading manufacturing operations within the semiconductor capital equipment sector.
* Hands‑on leadership over assembly, integration, testing, and shipment of complex capital equipment.
* Direct accountability for factory output, schedule adherence, shipment performance, and quality.
* Financial acumen across budgets, labor/overhead, capacity planning, and production financials.
* Executive‑level communication of results, risks, and strategy.
* History of building high‑performing teams in demanding environments.
* Expertise in Lean, structured problem‑solving, QMS, and data‑driven improvement.
* Decisive leader who drives accountability and effective decision‑making.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in semiconductor processing or precision capital equipment manufacturing.
* Leadership experience over ~100‑person organizations with multiple manager direct reports.
* Proven Lean/Six Sigma/Value Stream Mapping and CI program implementation.
* Experience with SAP, MES, and advanced manufacturing analytics.
* Demonstrated cycle‑time reduction, throughput improvement, and automated/modular final test deployment.
* Applied DfM in partnership with engineering/product development.
* Experience with international supply chains, global suppliers, and contract manufacturing.
* Familiarity with NPI, manufacturing transfer, and scaling production.

### **Ideal Profile**

A results‑oriented operations leader who blends deep technical manufacturing knowledge with operational discipline and sound business judgment. You thrive in low‑volume/high‑mix environments, elevate factory performance, and develop accountable teams. You’re equally effective on the floor and in the boardroom—communicating results, solving issues, and coaching leaders.

### **Location & Travel**

* Onsite leadership role in San Jose, California.
* Occasional domestic/international travel.

### **Core Strengths**

* Leadership/People Management; Bachelor’s Degree
* Cost Accounting; Cost Allocation; Financials; Revenue
* Lean Manufacturing Principles; Value Stream Mapping; Cycle‑Time
* Production Planning & Scheduling; Factory Ownership; Operations
* Supply Chain Management; Sourcing & Procurement
* Assembly; Capital Equipment; Complex Equipment; Semiconductor Experience; Test; Tooling; Physics
* SAP; Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

### **Tools & Technologies**

* Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
* Capital Equipment
* SAP
* Complex Equipment

### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
 
 
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

 

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements** 
 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.
* Capable of occasional travel as required by duties, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in diverse locations.
* Capable of operating a computer and other office productivity machinery, including a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
* Capable of frequently communicating with team members and stakeholders, accurately conveying detailed or important spoken instructions.
* Capable of perceiving visuals for activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer screen, and engaging in extensive reading.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Working Conditions** 
The working environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is exposed to:

* Traditional office environment
* Standard office equipment (computers, printers, phones, etc.)
* Well-illuminated environment
* Quiet to moderate noise level
* Occasional travel via car or plane to regional facilities, events, etc.
* Occasional subtle and mild scents related to operational facilities
* Occasional access to operational or warehouse facilities

 

### **Benefits**

**Total Compensation**

At Pacific Seafood your base wage is only a portion of your overall compensation package. We invest in our Team Members through a comprehensive and attractive total rewards package, including but not limited to:

* Health insurance benefits options, including medical, prescription, vision, dental, basic group life and short term disability.
* Flexible spending accounts for health flex and dependent care expenses
* 401(k) Retirement Plan options with generous annual company profit sharing match
* Paid time off for all regular FT team members, to include sick days, holiday pay, vacation, and personal time
* Employee Assistance Program- Confidential professional counseling, financial, and legal assistance provided at no charge to Team Members and immediate family members
* Product purchase program

Pacific Seafood is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

### **About Pacific Seafood**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are an excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Quality, Teamwork, Productivity, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and always striving to do better.

**General Summary:**

Oversees and gives direction to company production operations, including assembly, test, and integration departments. Develops and implements programs to ensure that finished products meet all engineering specifications and quality standards. Establishes standards and measurement systems to monitor production performance. Monitors the loading and execution of production assembly and test departments to meet company schedule and revenue requirements. Directs the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions. Reviews and approves the testing and evaluation methods of standard and special devices, monitoring and ensuring the conformance to all Astronics quality processes and procedures.

 

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manages production teams engaged in electronic or electro-mechanical assembly of precision components, subassemblies and finished products.
* Develops new or improved manufacturing processes and conducts manufacturing feasibility studies for proposed new product designs.
* Ensures the efficient flow of products through all phases of production.
* Collaborates with the finance organization in assuring the proper cost accounting procedures for production operations.
* Prepares and presents status reviews to Operations management on key production objectives such as reduction in defective assemblies and on-time delivery.
* Acts as liaison with the production planning organization regarding prioritization of production schedules and product delivery commitments.
* Supports the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions.
* Coordinates with the procurement organization to ensure that specialized parts, components, and materials acquired through subcontractors conform to technical specifications, quality standards and master project schedules.
* Performance management of direct reports. Develops and manages employee development goals and related training opportunities. Completes annual performance reviews of direct reports and recommends appropriate merit increases.
* Works with the customer service department to assure shared resources are allocated appropriately to meet all schedule demands.
* Performs corrective action investigations for both ICARS and CARS that have been issued to the production floor.
* May serve on cross-functional teams to address key operational issues.
* Responsible for ensuring all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations are observed wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
* Responsible for ensuring work is accomplished in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

 

**Job Qualifications:**

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field as well as 8–15+ years in manufacturing operations, with demonstrated P&L ownership and management responsibilities. Equivalent professional experience may be substituted in lieu of education. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, MBA, or equivalent is a plus.
* Demonstrates expertise in the application of operational principles, concepts, theory, and practice as well as project management and leadership skills including organization, planning, scheduling, and coordinating workloads to meet established deadlines and delivery schedules.
* Must possess the ability to resolve complex operational and production problems.
* Strong communication, leadership, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required to enable an effective interface with other departments, all levels of management, professional and support staff, customers, potential customers.
* Customer focused, must be able to work on a self-initiated basis and in a team environment, and able to work extended hours and travel as needed.

 

**Compensation:**

For individuals hired to work in California, Astronics Test Systems (ATS) is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to California. Any offer extended to a candidate will be based upon their unique set of knowledge, skills, education, and experience, as well as internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the range for this position is $145,000 - $160,000 annually.

 

**Employment Eligibility Requirements:**

* An offer of employment is contingent on successfully passing a drug test and background check
* This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary.

 

**Astronics Test Systems offers a competitive benefit package including:**

* **Stay Healthy**- Health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, FSA, HSA, as well as voluntary life/AD&D, voluntary critical illness, accident prevention and hospital indemnity
* **Save for the Future** - 401K & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* **Find Balance**- Employee Assistance Program & Wellness Program
* **Time for You**- Generous Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays and Paid Parental Leave
* **Professional Growth**- Tuition Reimbursement Program

**Accommodation Request:**

Astronics Test Systems is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please e-mail ats-ml-humanresources@astronics.com or call: 407.381.6062. We will make a determination regarding your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world's aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side-by-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
**Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?**

**Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.**

Prysmian, the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, strengthen its global team with the 2025 addition of Channell, now part of Prysmian. Founded by the Channell family in 1922, Channell brings a long‑standing legacy of innovation in outside plant infrastructure, serving Telecommunications, Municipalities, Internet Service Providers, Wireless, Water, Power, and CATV markets. Together, Prysmian and Channell team members are combining expertise, craftsmanship, and shared values to deliver a broader portfolio, from advanced cable systems and fiber connectivity solutions to enclosures and below‑grade vaults which support resilient infrastructure, the energy transition, and the growth of digital networks around the world.

When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.

For more than 140 years, Prysmian has helped shape the infrastructure that powers progress. From helping illuminate the Statue of Liberty in 1886 and delivering power from Hoover Dam to Los Angeles in 1935, to supporting New York City's rebuilding efforts after September 11, our cables and connectivity solutions have played a role in some of history's most significant milestones.

**What You’ll Bring:**

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, business administration, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience, including 5+ years leading multiple sites or a multi-plant network.
* Proven track record managing P&L, capital budgets, and operational KPIs across geographically dispersed facilities.
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies; certification (Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) preferred.
* Strong experience with ERP/MES systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, build high-performing teams, and manage change across a diverse, multi-site organization.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental regulations, and quality systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent).
* Experience in electronics, cable/connector, or precision component manufacturing a plus.
* Familiarity with thermoplastic molding - low and high pressure injection molding, rotational molding, and blow molding
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to 40–50%) between facilities, including international travel as applicable.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and the board.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-site manufacturing environment.

**What You'll Do:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the company's multi-site manufacturing network. This role is accountable for driving safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery performance at every facility while building a consistent operating system, talent pipeline, and culture of continuous improvement across locations.

The Director partners closely with Plant Managers, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and HR to ensure each site operates at world-class levels and that capacity, capital, and talent decisions support the company's growth and customer commitments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and execute the multi-site manufacturing operations strategy in alignment with overall business goals, growth plans, and customer demand.
* Establish and standardize a common operating system (KPIs, daily management, tiered accountability meetings) across all plants to ensure consistent execution and visibility.
* Set annual operating and capital budgets for all locations; own P&L accountability for manufacturing operations.
* Drive productivity, throughput, and cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining or improving quality and service levels.
* Lead capacity planning, footprint strategy, and capital investment decisions across the network, including new equipment, line expansions, or facility consolidations.
* Directly manage and develop Plant Managers/Site Leaders at each location, setting clear performance expectations and holding sites accountable to targets.
* Build bench strength and succession plans for critical operations roles across all sites; partner with HR on talent acquisition, development, and retention strategies.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement; conduct regular site visits and gemba walks.
* Standardize best practices across facilities and lead cross-site knowledge sharing to eliminate performance variability between plants.
* Champion an EHS-first culture; ensure all locations meet or exceed OSHA and applicable regulatory requirements, with measurable reduction in incident rates.
* Ensure consistent adherence to quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and customer quality requirements across all sites.
* Oversee compliance with environmental, labor, and applicable trade/export regulations at each facility.
* Lead deployment of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and/or Continuous Improvement methodologies across all locations.
* Drive standardization of processes, work instructions, and systems (ERP/MES) to improve consistency, data integrity, and decision-making across sites.
* Identify and lead major process improvement, automation, and cost-savings projects with measurable ROI.
* Partner with Supply Chain/Planning to align production schedules with demand, inventory targets, and on-time delivery goals.
* Collaborate with Engineering on new product introductions, process qualifications, and manufacturability improvements.
* Work with Finance on cost accounting, standard costs, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Partner with HR on workforce planning, labor relations, compensation strategy, and organizational design across sites.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, reporting operational performance and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and/or the board as needed.

**You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, build strong partnerships, and grow your career in a business that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.**

**Total Rewards Designed for You:**

We believe great people deserve great rewards. That’s why Prysmian offers a total rewards package designed to support your financial, physical, and personal well-being now and as your career grows.

* **Competitive salary** that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions
* **Performance-based incentives** that reward your results and impact *(where applicable)*
* **Comprehensive health coverage** with medical, dental, and vision plan options to fit your needs
* **401(k) retirement savings plan** with a competitive company match to help you invest in your future
* **Paid maternity and bonding leave, plus adoption assistance** to support you and your growing family
* **Generous paid time off and company holidays** so you can rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most
* **Life and disability insurance** for added peace of mind
* **Wellness programs and supplemental insurance options** to support your overall health and well-being

**At Prysmian, you’ll be supported at work, at home, and throughout every stage of your career.**

**Overview**

**Plant Manager – Commercial Laundry** 
**Premier Linen Services | Fort Myers, FL | Full-Time | $85,000 – $125,000 per year**

**About us** 
Premier Linen Services runs an advanced, state-of-the-art commercial laundry facility serving large and luxury hospitality properties across Florida. We’re a growing, owner-led company with a modern, high-volume plant, and we’re looking for a hands-on leader to keep it running safely and efficiently every day.

**About the role** 
The Plant Manager runs daily operations across our production facility. You’ll keep production moving through washing, drying, finishing and packaging, work with maintenance and logistics, and lead a team focused on quality, safety and on-time delivery.

What you’ll do

* Oversee day-to-day plant operations and make sure production goals are met
* Supervise and develop department supervisors, shift leads and production staff
* Carry out production plans, adjusting schedules and staffing to meet customer demand
* Watch real-time output, quality and downtime, and fix problems quickly
* Work with maintenance and logistics to keep equipment running and production uninterrupted
* Build a strong safety culture through inspections, training and quick action on hazards
* Help control labor, material and utility costs while keeping quality high
* Track and report KPIs for productivity, quality and safety to leadership
* Lead continuous improvement and lean initiatives on the plant floor

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–5+ years of experience as a plant manager, production manager or similar leader, preferably in commercial laundry, manufacturing or textiles
* Proven ability to lead and motivate teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Strong organizational, communication and problem-solving skills
* Calm and decisive under pressure, able to handle emergencies
* Comfortable with Microsoft Office and production software
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Fluent in English and Spanish (Preferred)

**Working conditions** 
This is a plant-floor role in an industrial laundry, with heat, humidity, noise and chemicals. It requires long periods of standing and walking, and the ability to lift and push up to 50 lbs. The schedule is flexible and based on production needs.

What we offer

* Salary of $85,000 – $125,000, based on experience
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* A leadership role with a growing, owner-led company

***Premier Linen Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

Pay: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Description - Head of Manufacturing- Promotional Products & Custom Manufacturing Company: Stealth Mode Three Department: Operations Location: Richmond, TX (On-site) Employment type: Full-time Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 per year Original apply URL: https://www.stealthmodethree.com/careers/job\_a46ed593ff5e48d59c33 About the Role We are seeking an experienced Head of Manufacturing to lead and scale our production operation in Richmond, Texas. This is not a traditional general-manufacturing management role. We are looking for a leader who understands the unique demands of the promotional products and custom merchandise industry — where every day can involve changing order volumes, customized products, tight deadlines, multiple production methods, material constraints, and constantly shifting priorities. The ideal candidate has experience leading production in promotional products, decorated apparel, custom merchandise, commercial printing, signage, embroidery, DTF/DTG, screen printing, heat transfer, or a similar high-mix production environment. You will own the operational performance of the manufacturing organization and work closely with leadership and other departments to build a reliable, scalable, high-performing production operation. As Head of Manufacturing, you will be responsible for translating customer demand into an efficient production operation. You will lead the people, processes, equipment, materials, and systems required to consistently deliver orders on time, at the expected quality, and at the right cost. You will be expected to identify bottlenecks before they become problems, establish clear accountability across the production team, and continuously improve how work moves through the facility. The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing a print shop or production environment and be comfortable taking ownership of production performance from start to finish. Responsibilities Production & Operations - Own daily production operations and overall manufacturing performance. - Plan and prioritize production based on order volume, deadlines, capacity, materials, and available labor. - Establish production schedules and adjust priorities as demand changes. - Monitor throughput, turnaround time, capacity utilization, labor efficiency, quality, and waste. - Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. - Ensure orders move efficiently from intake through production, quality control, and fulfillment. People Leadership - Lead, develop, and hold production employees and supervisors accountable. - Establish clear expectations and performance standards. - Build a culture centered on ownership, urgency, quality, and continuous improvement. - Recruit and train production talent as the organization grows. - Develop cross-training and workforce-flexibility strategies to reduce production disruption. - Address performance issues quickly and fairly through coaching, documentation, and accountability. Promotional Products Manufacturing - Understand the operational requirements of customized and made-to-order products. - Coordinate different production methods, equipment, materials, and workflows. - Optimize production sequencing and batch similar work where appropriate. - Understand the impact of artwork, materials, production methods, finishing, and fulfillment on turnaround time and quality. - Work closely with other departments to ensure production requirements are understood before orders reach the floor. Quality & Continuous Improvement - Establish and maintain quality standards and production controls. - Identify root causes of defects, rework, delays, and production failures. - Develop SOPs, work instructions, checklists, and visual standards. - Implement process improvements that increase throughput while reducing waste and errors. - Establish meaningful KPIs and use data to drive operational decisions. Inventory, Equipment & Materials - Maintain appropriate inventory levels and production material availability. - Partner with purchasing and supply chain to anticipate material requirements. - Monitor material usage, waste, and production costs. - Coordinate equipment maintenance and respond quickly to equipment failures. - Develop contingency plans for equipment downtime and capacity constraints. Cross-Functional Leadership - Partner with Sales, Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse, and company leadership. - Establish clear communication around production capacity, deadlines, shortages, and delays. - Help ensure sales commitments align with actual production capacity. - Provide leadership with visibility into production performance and constraints. Requirements The strongest candidates will have: - 5+ years of production or manufacturing leadership experience. - Direct experience in promotional products, custom merchandise, decorated apparel, printing, signage, or a closely related industry. - Experience managing high-volume, customized or made-to-order production. - Experience managing production teams and supervisors. - Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and capacity management. - Experience using KPIs to manage throughput, quality, labor, turnaround, waste, and cost. - Strong understanding of inventory and material planning. - Experience with equipment maintenance, downtime, and production contingencies. - Demonstrated process-improvement experience. - Experience creating and implementing SOPs. - Strong employee-management and accountability skills. - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. - A hands-on leadership style and willingness to spend significant time on the production floor. Preferred Industry Experience Experience with any of the following is highly valuable: - Promotional products - Branded merchandise - Custom apparel - DTF printing - DTG printing - Screen printing - Embroidery - Heat press / heat transfer - Digital printing - Large-format printing - Sign manufacturing - Custom merchandise production - Fulfillment of personalized or made-to-order products Schedule Ability to work full-time, Monday through Friday, on-site in Richmond, Texas. Benefits - $80,000–$120,000 annual salary - Leadership position with significant ownership and responsibility - Opportunity to help scale and improve a growing manufacturing operation - Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment - Opportunity for long-term growth within the organization**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

**Overview**

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit human services organization founded in 1943. Today, it has grown to be the largest provider of licensed outpatient community behavioral health services and one of the largest human service agencies in Westchester County. WJCS delivers innovative programs and services and compassionate care to more than 20,000 people of all ages and backgrounds throughout the county.

We are currently seeking a full-time Director of Quality Assurance to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for investigations, clinical compliance, implementation of quality initiatives, incident information collection and monitoring, and other duties as assigned.

The salary range for this full-time position is $110,000.

**Responsibilities**

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Investigates reportable incidents and notable occurrences within clinics, satellite programs and trauma division.
* Maintains records related to incidents; chairs required meetings as needed.
* Provides required incident information to be entered into NIMRS (OMH Incident Reporting and Management Application).
* Monitors required data metrics that are reported to regulatory bodies (i.e. OMH/OASAS/SAMHSA)
* Implements and tracks annual quality improvement initiatives.
* Identifies, implements and monitors staff trainings necessary for CCBHC licensure.
* Reviews and makes necessary changes to clinic policies and procedures.
* Investigates clinic compliance issues as assigned.
* Develops, distributes, and tabulates responses for the annual Consumer Satisfaction Surveys
* Conduct annual audit as requested.
* Completes necessary documents related to CBCHC and OMH/OASAS recertification and audit requests as needed.
* Acts as liaison with Utilization Review process.
* Attends Clinic Leadership, Clinic Transformation, compliance and other required meetings.

**Requirements**

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

* Master’s Degree in Social Work or PhD in Psychology preferred
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in community behavioral health settings, with leadership skills preferred
* Knowledge of OMH, OASAS and SAMHSA regulations
* Ability to investigate incidents, including allegations of abuse
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work closely with members of the executive staff ( i.e. CMO, CCO) and direct service staff
* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent critical thinking & writing skills
* Excellent computer skills
* Excellent knowledge of OMH, OASAS, OPWDD, SAMHSA & CCBHC regulations
* Excellent clinical and diagnostic skills

**What WJCS has to offer you**

In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* Generous paid time off
* Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
* 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
* Ongoing Professional Development and Training
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
* Disability and life insurance
* Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives

**WJCS INC. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**
------------------------------

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**
